subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron/run status and expose the shared yielded-parent lifecycle classifier/callback through plugin-facing surfaces in this PR?
rationale: The code path appears coherent, but the PR creates protocol, CLI/UI, hook, and SDK contract surface that automation should not approve without maintainer product/compatibility intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require a clean rebase, redacted Discord status/progress proof, and upgrade/contract proof before allowing the public `deferred` and SDK surfaces to land.

options.title: Split internal fix from public contract
options.body: Keep only the internal yielded-parent repair path here and move the public status/SDK additions to a smaller maintainer-sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Accept contract risk now
options.body: Merge after source review and CI, knowingly accepting unproven Discord behavior and downstream client/plugin compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require a clean rebase, redacted Discord status/progress proof, and upgrade/contract proof before allowing the public `deferred` and SDK surfaces to land.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is public product/API contract acceptance rather than a narrow implementation fix, and steipete is the strongest current main-integration signal in the inspected history.
